correctness.rationale: The full-sphere and conditional orthant Gram matrices of bases (1,x+y+z,xy+yz+zx) and (x−y,x²−y²,z(x−y)) follow from 3-variable absolute-Gaussian gamma moments. S3 representation splits the nine-dimensional V2 into 3 trivial and 3 copies of its 2d standard type, giving one cubic and a repeated cubic; generalized eigenvalues of (C/8,B) exhaust the spectrum. Symbolic checker orthant_band2_verify.py reconstructs full 9×9 moments, Shannon trace 9/8, exact B,C blocks and determines disjoint rational root isolating intervals via Machin-series π bounds; independent numerical generalized eigensolves confirm the six values and κ=362.61139026488. Rigorously isolated distinct intervals certify unique extremizers, not just approximate eigenvalues.
